purpose: Teach: 美奈子/貞子/アヤ/マサ/わらしべ/ガンモ/キチン/逸品

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの美奈子と話してたな
lines.en: Riku, weren't you talking to Minako from the class next door?
lines.style: Light, teasing observation. Quick delivery, eyes narrowing slightly with amusement. Testing him. Not accusing — just noting what she saw.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ホラー「リング」の貞子のコスプレ怖かったな、桜
lines.en: Oh, that Sadako costume you did for Ring was actually terrifying, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting with dry humor. Quick counter-volley, almost a smile. Not quite meeting her eyes but relaxed. Turning it back on her without heat.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスのアヤと仲良いな
lines.en: Riku, you seem pretty close with Aya from the next class too.
lines.style: Pressing gently, watching his reaction. Casual surface but there's an edge underneath — she's testing how much he'll admit. Leaning against something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣のクラスのマサとも仲良いな、桜
lines.en: Well, you're pretty close with Masa from next door too, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Returning fire, keeping pace. Quick and light but with a point. Not defensive — just playing the same game back. Slight smirk in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、国語でわらしべ長者習ったろ
lines.en: Riku, didn't you learn that folk tale about the straw millionaire in Japanese class?
lines.style: Shifting ground abruptly, genuine curiosity now. Less teasing, more sincere. Lifting her head slightly like she's genuinely asking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科でガンモ、つまりがんもどき作ったろ、桜
lines.en: You made ganmo — that's the mock tofu thing — in home ec, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Following her lead into new territory. Curious but still playing. Slightly self-conscious about admitting what he made. Voice lighter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、生物でキチン質、つまり甲殻の構造習ったろ
lines.en: Riku, didn't you study the structure of chitin — you know, in crustacean exoskeletons — in biology?
lines.style: Continuing the volley, genuine interest creeping in. Less teasing now, more like she's actually comparing notes. Slight warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家族で京都旅行で逸品和菓子買ったろ、桜
lines.en: You bought some really nice wagashi — those fancy Japanese sweets — on a family trip to Kyoto, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft landing. Voice warming slightly. Still playful but almost intimate now — like they're showing each other small true things. Gentle and knowing.
